caption: The video captures a large, blackened tree stump standing in an open grassy field, with a small Amazon cardboard box positioned at its base. The box is already alight at the excerpt's start, bright orange and yellow flames licking up the right side of the charred trunk. A mound of burning debris and grey ash sits just to the right of the box, while a flattened sheet of cardboard lies undisturbed in the foreground. Throughout the excerpt the fire burns continuously, its tongues flickering, stretching, and shifting shape as they climb higher along the stump's surface. The flames gradually spread from the right flank toward the left, wrapping around the box and the base of the trunk in a wider glow. Faint wisps of smoke rise above the top of the stump as the blaze broadens. The box itself stays in place, its printed smile logo still visible beneath the consuming fire. The line of bare trees in the background and the discarded cardboard in front remain static, framing the active blaze. The fire continues to burn vigorously through the final frames, neither extinguished nor fully consumed.
